words.tr: n. 缩写
words.ex: The word 'abbr' is an abbr for 'abbreviation'.
words.ex_cn: ‘abbr’ 是 ‘abbreviation’ 的缩写。
words.en: An abbreviation is a short form of a word or phrase.

words.tr: v. 使简短；缩写
words.ex: He abbreviates the word 'example' as 'ex.'.
words.ex_cn: 他把单词 'example' 缩写为 'ex.'。
words.en: To abbreviate something means to make it shorter, especially by using a particular word or phrase to represent it.

words.tr: n. 缩写；缩略
words.ex: He used an abbreviation for 'company' in his note.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记中用了'company'的缩写。
words.en: An abbreviation is a shortened form of a word or phrase.

words.tr: phrase. 抽象名词：表示抽象概念、状态、品质或情感的名词，如“love”（爱）、“freedom”（自由）、“happiness”（幸福）等，不能通过感官直接感知
words.ex: Love is an abstract noun that represents a deep emotional connection.
words.ex_cn: 爱是一个代表深厚情感连接的抽象名词。
words.en: An abstract noun is a noun that refers to an idea, quality, or state rather than a physical object.

words.tr: adj. 宾格的；指责的 n. 宾格
words.ex: In Latin, the noun changes its form in the accusative case.
words.ex_cn: 在拉丁语中，名词在宾格情况下会改变其形式。
words.en: In grammar, the accusative is the case used for a noun when it is the direct object of a verb, or when it is governed by a preposition. In some languages, it is also used for the object of certain verbs.

words.tr: adj. 活跃的；积极的；主动的；
words.ex: He is an active student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上是一个活跃的学生。
words.en: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

words.tr: n. 形容词；
words.ex: The word 'happy' is an adjective.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'happy' 是一个形容词。
words.en: An adjective is a word that describes a noun or pronoun. In grammar, an adjective is a word whose main syntactic role is to modify a noun or pronoun, giving more information about the noun or pronoun's referent.

words.tr: 短语. 欢迎回家
words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.tr: n. 副词
words.ex: He speaks slowly, using an adverb to describe how he talks.
words.ex_cn: 他说话很慢，用一个副词来描述他说话的方式。
words.en: An adverb is a word that modifies a verb, an adjective, another adverb, or a whole sentence, often answering questions such as how?, when?, where?, or to what extent?.

words.tr: adj. 副词的；状语的
words.ex: He used an adverbial to describe how he ran.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个状语来描述他是如何跑的。
words.en: Relating to or functioning as an adverb; a word or phrase that modifies or qualifies an adjective, verb, or other adverb or a word group, expressing a relation of place, time, circumstance, manner, cause, degree, etc.

words.tr: v. 附加；
words.ex: He affixed a stamp to the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把邮票贴在信封上。
words.en: To attach, fasten, or join something to something else.

words.tr:
n. 前情；先行词；祖先（常复）
adj. 在 ... 之前的
words.ex: The word 'dog' is the antecedent of 'it' in this sentence.
words.ex_cn: 在这句话中，'dog' 是 'it' 的先行词。
words.en: An antecedent is a thing or event that existed before or logically precedes another.

words.tr: n. 〈语法〉同格；同位；并置；附着作用
words.ex: The teacher called him a genius, in apposition to his name.
words.ex_cn: 老师称他为天才，与他的名字构成同格。
words.en: Apposition is a grammatical construction in which two elements, normally noun phrases, are placed side by side, with one element serving to define or modify the other.

words.tr: n. 文章；条款；
words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.tr: n. 方面；
words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.tr: adj. 定语的
words.ex: The word 'red' is an attributive in 'red car'.
words.ex_cn: 在 'red car' 中，'red' 是一个限定词。
words.en: An attributive adjective is an adjective that is placed before the noun it modifies, without a linking verb.

words.tr: n. 辅助的；辅助物；辅助设备
words.ex: He uses an aux cable to connect his phone to the speaker.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一个辅助线缆将手机连接到扬声器。
words.en: Auxiliary: providing supplementary or additional support; often used in military or technical contexts.

words.tr:
adj. 辅助的；附属的
n. 辅助物；附属物；助动词
words.ex: He used an auxiliary verb to form the past tense.
words.ex_cn: 他使用了一个助动词来构成过去时。
words.en: An auxiliary is a person or thing that provides additional help or support.

words.tr: phrase. 助动词
words.ex: In the sentence 'She can swim', 'can' is an auxiliary verb.
words.ex_cn: 在句子'She can swim'中，'can'是一个助动词。
words.en: An auxiliary verb is a verb that adds functional or grammatical meaning to the clause in which it appears, such as to express tense, aspect, modality, voice, emphasis, etc.

words.tr: n. 情况；事例；案件；外壳；容器（箱，盒）；
words.ex: In this case, we should wait longer.
words.ex_cn: 在这种情况下，我们应该再等一会儿。
words.en: A particular situation or example of something.

words.tr: phrase. 格尾；格词尾（指名词、代词等词类在不同语法格中所添加的词尾变化）
words.ex: In Latin, the case ending of a noun changes depending on its role in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 在拉丁语中，名词的词尾变化取决于其在句子中的作用。
words.en: A case ending is a suffix on a noun, pronoun, or adjective that indicates its grammatical function in a phrase, clause, or sentence.

words.tr: phrase. 表示因果关系的连词，用于连接表示原因和结果的句子或短语，如“because”、“since”、“as”等
words.ex: Because is a causal conjunction that introduces a reason.
words.ex_cn: 因为是一个引入原因的因果连词。
words.en: A causal conjunction is a word or phrase that connects two clauses or sentences and shows a cause-and-effect relationship between them.

words.tr: n. 从句；条款
words.ex: The sentence has a clause that explains why he left.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子有一个解释他为什么离开的从句。
words.en: A clause is a particular section of a legal document such as a contract, will, or treaty, that contains a condition or stipulation.

words.tr: phrase. 集合名词；表示一组人或事物的名词
words.ex: The word 'team' is a collective noun.
words.ex_cn: 单词'team'是一个集合名词。
words.en: A collective noun is a noun that refers to a group of individuals, such as 'team,' 'jury,' 'flock,' 'herd,' etc.

words.tr: phrase. 普通名词：表示一类人、事物、地点或概念的名词，而不是特定的个体，如 'dog'、'city'、'book' 等
words.ex: Dog is a common noun.
words.ex_cn: n. 'Dog'是一个普通名词。
words.en: A common noun is a noun that denotes a class of objects or a concept as opposed to a particular individual.

words.tr: adj. 比较的；相对的；
words.ex: This is a comparative study of two languages.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个关于两种语言的比较研究。
words.en: You use comparative to show that you are judging something against a previous or different situation. For example, if you say that something is comparative luxury, you mean that it is luxurious compared to something else.

words.tr: n. 比较；对比；
words.ex: The comparison of the two phones helped me decide.
words.ex_cn: 对这两部手机的比较帮助我做出了决定。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences or similarities between them.

words.tr:
v. 补充；与…相辅相成；
n. 补足物；补语；余角；
words.ex: The red scarf complements her blue coat.
words.ex_cn: 这条红围巾补充了她的蓝外套。
words.en: To complement something means to make it complete or perfect by adding something to it.

words.tr:
adj. 复杂的；
n. 综合楼（群）；
words.ex: The instructions are too complex for children.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明对孩子来说太复杂了。
words.en: Something that is complex has many different parts, and is therefore often difficult to understand.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.tr: n. 一致；和睦；协调
words.ex: The two countries reached a concord on trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家在贸易上达成了一致。
words.en: Concord is a state of agreement or harmony between people or groups.

words.tr: 名词短语。具体名词，指表示看得见、摸得着的人或事物的名词，如“book”（书）、“dog”（狗）等
words.ex: The word 'apple' is a concrete noun because it refers to something we can see and touch.
words.ex_cn: 单词'apple'是一个具体名词，因为它指的是我们可以看到和触摸的东西。
words.en: A concrete noun is a noun that refers to a physical object rather than to a quality or idea.

words.tr: adj. 依…而定的；附带条件的；
words.ex: The prize is conditional on winning the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个奖品取决于是否赢得比赛。
words.en: A conditional action or agreement depends on something else happening or being done.

words.tr: n. 连接词，连词
words.ex: And, but, and or are common conj.
words.ex_cn: 和、但是和或者是常见的连词。
words.en: A word used to connect clauses, phrases, or words, such as 'and', 'but', or 'because'.

words.tr: n. 同时发生；连接词；
words.ex: The rain and the thunder happened in conjunction.
words.ex_cn: 雨和雷声同时发生。
words.en: A conjunction is a word that is used to connect clauses or sentences or to coordinate words in the same clause.

words.tr: v. 列举动词的词形变化
words.ex: He conjugates verbs in French class.
words.ex_cn: 他在法语课上变位动词。
words.en: To conjugate a verb means to give its different forms in a particular tense, according to the person and number of the subject. In chemistry, conjugate refers to a pair of substances that are related by the gain or loss of a proton.

words.tr: n. 结合；动词变化
words.ex: The conjugation of verbs in Spanish is complex.
words.ex_cn: 西班牙语中动词的词形变化很复杂。
words.en: Conjugation refers to the variation of the form of a verb in an inflected language such as Latin, by which are distinguished voice, mood, tense, number, and person.

words.tr: adj. 连结的
words.ex: The word 'and' is a connective.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'and' 是一个连接词。
words.en: A connective is a word or phrase that links clauses or sentences. In anatomy, it refers to tissue that connects, supports, or separates other tissues or organs.

words.tr: n. 建筑；建设；
words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.tr: adj. 继续的；连续的；
words.ex: The rain was continuous all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨一整天都在下个不停。
words.en: Something that is continuous happens or exists without stopping or being interrupted.

words.tr: n. 收缩；挛缩；缩小
words.ex: The contraction of the muscle helps you move your arm.
words.ex_cn: 肌肉的收缩帮助你移动手臂。
words.en: A contraction is a process of becoming smaller or shorter, or a word that is made shorter by leaving out some letters.

words.tr: phrase. 并列从句；在复合句中地位相等、用并列连词连接的两个或多个从句
words.ex: In the sentence 'I like apples, and she likes oranges,' 'and she likes oranges' is a coordinate clause.
words.ex_cn: 在句子“我喜欢苹果，而她喜欢橙子”中，“而她喜欢橙子”是一个并列从句。
words.en: A coordinate clause is a clause that is connected to another clause of equal rank by a coordinating conjunction.

words.tr: phrase. 并列连词，用来连接语法上对等的词、短语或句子，如 and、but、or 等
words.ex: In the sentence 'I like tea and coffee', 'and' is a coordinating conjunction.
words.ex_cn: 在句子“我喜欢茶和咖啡”中，“和”是一个并列连词。
words.en: A coordinating conjunction is a word that joins two elements of equal grammatical rank and syntactic importance.

words.tr: n. 系词；连接词
words.ex: In the sentence 'The sky is blue,' 'is' serves as the copula.
words.ex_cn: 在句子'天空是蓝色的'中，'是'作为系词。
words.en: A copula is a word used to link the subject of a sentence with a predicate (a subject complement or an adverbial).

words.tr: adj. 可数的；可计数的
words.ex: Apples are countable things.
words.ex_cn: 苹果是可数的东西。
words.en: Capable of being counted; denumerable.

words.tr: phrase. 可数名词（指可以计数的人、事物或概念，有单数和复数形式）
words.ex: Books are count nouns because you can say one book or two books.
words.ex_cn: 书是可数名词，因为你可以说一本书或两本书。
words.en: A count noun is a noun that can be counted and therefore has a plural form, such as 'dog' or 'chair'.

words.tr: n.& adj. 与格（的）
words.ex: The dative case in Latin indicates the indirect object.
words.ex_cn: 拉丁语中的与格表示间接宾语。
words.en: In grammar, the dative case is a grammatical case used in some languages to indicate the noun to which something is given.

words.tr: n. 词尾变化；变格；倾斜；衰退
words.ex: The declension of nouns in Latin is complex.
words.ex_cn: 拉丁语名词的变格很复杂。
words.en: The inflection of nouns, pronouns, and adjectives in regard to case, number, and gender.

words.tr: phrase. 定冠词（如英语中的 the，用于特指某人或某物）
words.ex: The cat is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子上。
words.en: In English, the definite article is the word 'the', which is used to refer to a particular member of a group or class.

words.tr:
adj. 明白表示的；证实的；公然表示情绪的
n. 指示词
words.ex: He is demonstrative with his love for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他对家人表达爱意时很外露。
words.en: If you are demonstrative, you show your feelings or behave in a way that shows your love for someone.

words.tr: phrase. 指示代词（如 this, that, these, those，用来指代特定的人或事物）
words.ex: This is my book.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的书。
words.en: A demonstrative pronoun is a pronoun that is used to point to something specific within a sentence.

words.tr: phrase. 从属子句；依赖性从句（不能独立成句，需依附主句的句子结构）
words.ex: A dependent clause cannot stand alone as a sentence.
words.ex_cn: n. 从属从句不能单独作为一个句子存在。
words.en: A dependent clause is a group of words that contains a subject and verb but does not express a complete thought and cannot stand alone as a sentence.

words.tr: n. 限定词
words.ex: The word 'this' is a determiner.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'this' 是一个限定词。
words.en: A determiner is a word that is used before a noun to show which particular example of the noun you are referring to.

words.tr: phrase. 直接引语；直接陈述（指原话引用某人所说的话，不加改动）
words.ex: In her essay, she used direct discourse to quote the president's speech.
words.ex_cn: 在她的文章中，她使用直接引语引用了总统的演讲。
words.en: Direct discourse is a way of reporting speech or thought by quoting the exact words spoken or thought, usually enclosed in quotation marks.

words.tr: phrase. 直接引语；直接引述（说话者原话的引用）
words.ex: She said, 'I am happy.' is an example of direct speech.
words.ex_cn: 她说，‘我很高兴。’ 是直接引语的例子。
words.en: Direct speech is a way of reporting what someone has said by quoting their exact words, enclosed in quotation marks.

words.tr: phrase. 直接宾语（语法中接受动作的名词或代词）
words.ex: In the sentence 'She gave him a book', 'a book' is the direct object.
words.ex_cn: 在句子'她给了他一本书'中，'一本书'是直接宾语。
words.en: In grammar, the direct object is the noun or pronoun that receives the action of the verb directly.

words.tr: phrase. 转折连词；表示选择或对比关系的连词，如“or”、“but”等
words.ex: The word 'but' is a disjunctive conjunction that introduces a contrast.
words.ex_cn: n. 'but'这个词是一个转折连词，用于引出一个对比。
words.en: A disjunctive conjunction is a word that connects words, phrases, or clauses that contrast or oppose each other, such as 'but', 'however', or 'nevertheless'.

words.tr: phrase. 双及物动词（指可以同时带直接宾语和间接宾语的动词）
words.ex: In the sentence 'She gave me a book', 'gave' is a ditransitive verb.
words.ex_cn: 在句子'她给了我一本书'中，'gave'是一个双及物动词。
words.en: A ditransitive verb is a verb that takes both a direct object and an indirect object.

words.tr: phrase. 双重否定的；指句子中使用两个否定词，通常在标准语法中表示肯定，但在某些方言或语境中可能加强否定语气
words.ex: Using a double negative in a sentence can make it confusing.
words.ex_cn: 在句子中使用双重否定可能会让人感到困惑。
words.en: A double negative is a grammatical construction that uses two negative words in the same clause, which can sometimes result in a positive meaning depending on the language.

words.tr: abbr. 股息除外；“ex dividend”的缩写
words.ex: The stock price rose after the earnings report, ex-dividend.
words.ex_cn: 在除息后，股价上涨了。
words.en: Ed is the abbreviation for education, which refers to the process of receiving or giving systematic instruction, especially at a school or university.

words.tr: n. 结束；结局； v. 结束；“end”的现在分词；
words.ex: The ending of the movie was surprising.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的结束令人惊讶。
words.en: The final part of something, especially a story, movie, or play.

words.tr: suffix. 表示最高级
words.ex: He is the tallest in his class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班里最高的。
words.en: suffix. Used to form the superlative degree of adjectives and adverbs.

words.tr: suffix. 古英语动词第三人称单数现在时的词尾
words.ex: He runneth faster than anyone in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比村里的任何人都快。
words.en: An archaic suffix used to form the third person singular present indicative of verbs.

words.tr: adj. 女性的；
words.ex: She has a feminine voice.
words.ex_cn: 她的声音很女性化。
words.en: having qualities or an appearance traditionally associated with women, especially delicacy and prettiness.

words.tr: phrase. 限定动词（在人称和数上与主语一致的动词形式，用于表示时态）
words.ex: In the sentence 'She runs every morning.', 'runs' is a finite verb.
words.ex_cn: 在句子“她每天早上跑步。”中，“runs”是一个限定动词。
words.en: A finite verb is a verb that is inflected for person and for tense according to the rules and categories of the languages in which it occurs.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.tr: phrase. 功能；作用；函数；典礼，仪式
words.ex: The function word helps connect ideas in a sentence.
words.ex_cn: 功能词帮助连接句子中的意思。
words.en: A function word (e.g., preposition, article) has little meaning on its own but shows grammatical relationships.

words.tr: phrase. 将来时；表示将来动作或状态的动词时态
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会去公园。
words.en: The future tense is a verb tense used to talk about something that will happen or will be true in the future.

words.tr: n. 性别；
words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.tr: adj. 属格的；所有格的
words.ex: In 'the boy's book', 'boy's' is in the genitive case.
words.ex_cn: 在'the boy's book'中，'boy's'是属格形式。
words.en: The genitive case is a grammatical case that marks a noun as modifying another noun, often indicating possession, though it can also indicate other relationships.

words.tr: n. 动名词
words.ex: She likes swimming, which is a gerund.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢游泳，这是一个动名词。
words.en: A gerund is a noun formed from a verb which refers to an action, process, or state. In English, gerunds end in -ing (e.g., 'swimming' in 'Swimming is good exercise.').

words.tr: adj. 可分的；可分类的；可分级的
words.ex: The test is designed to be gradable according to the student's ability.
words.ex_cn: 这个测试设计成可以根据学生的能力进行分级。
words.en: Capable of being graded or classified.

words.tr: n. 语法
words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.tr: n. 语法专家；文法家；语言学专家；
words.ex: The grammarian corrected the student's sentence.
words.ex_cn: 语法专家纠正了学生的句子。
words.en: A grammarian is a person who studies and writes about grammar.

words.tr: adj. 语法上的；
words.ex: The sentence has a grammatical error.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子有一个语法错误。
words.en: Relating to grammar or the rules of grammar.

words.tr: phrase. 历史现在时（一种修辞手法，用现在时叙述过去事件以增强生动性）
words.ex: In his novel, the author uses the historic present to make the past events more vivid.
words.ex_cn: n. 在他的小说中，作者使用历史现在时使过去的事件更加生动。
words.en: The historic present is a grammatical construction in which present tense is used to narrate past events, often to make the narration more vivid or immediate.

words.tr: n. 同形（同音）异义词；同名异物
words.ex: The words 'bear' and 'bare' are homonyms.
words.ex_cn: “bear”和“bare”这两个词是同音异义词。
words.en: A homonym is a word that is pronounced the same as another word but differs in meaning. The words may be spelled the same, such as 'rose' (flower) and 'rose' (past tense of rise), or differently, such as 'carat', 'caret', and 'carrot'.

words.tr: n. 同音异形异义字
words.ex: The words 'to', 'two', and 'too' are homophones.
words.ex_cn: 单词'to'，'two'和'too'是同音异形异义字。
words.en: A word that is pronounced the same as another word but differs in meaning, and may differ in spelling.

words.tr:
adj. 极重要的；
n. 紧急的事；
words.ex: It is imperative to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水非常重要。
words.en: If it is imperative that something is done, that thing is extremely important and must be done.

words.tr: adj. 不受个人感情影响的；没有人情味的；
words.ex: The judge gave an impersonal decision based on the law.
words.ex_cn: 法官基于法律作出了不受个人感情影响的判决。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as impersonal, you mean that they do not show any emotion about the person they are dealing with.

words.tr: phrase. 不定冠词（英语中的 'a' 或 'an'）
words.ex: I saw a cat on the street.
words.ex_cn: 我在街上看到一只猫。
words.en: An indefinite article is a determiner (a, an) that introduces a noun phrase and implies that the thing referred to is nonspecific.

words.tr: phrase. 独立分句；主句（可独立成句，包含主语和谓语，不依赖其他分句表达完整意思）
words.ex: An independent clause can stand alone as a sentence.
words.ex_cn: 独立分句可以单独作为一个句子。
words.en: An independent clause is a group of words that contains a subject and a verb and expresses a complete thought. An independent clause is a sentence.

words.tr: adj. 指示的；标示的；
words.ex: The map has an indicative arrow to show the way.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图上有一个指示方向的箭头。
words.en: If one thing is indicative of another, it suggests what the other thing is likely to be.

words.tr: phrase. 间接引语；间接话语（用转述方式而非原话引用他人言辞）
words.ex: He told me he was tired, which is an example of indirect discourse.
words.ex_cn: 他告诉我他累了，这是间接引语的一个例子。
words.en: Indirect discourse is a grammatical construction in which the reported speech is not quoted directly but is instead paraphrased or summarized.

words.tr: phrase. 间接引语；转述语
words.ex: He told me that he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他告诉我他累了。
words.en: Indirect speech is a means of expressing the content of statements, questions, or other utterances without quoting them explicitly as is done in direct speech.

words.tr: phrase. 间接宾语（在句子中接受直接宾语所代表事物的对象，通常回答“给谁/为谁”等问题）
words.ex: She gave him a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了他一本书。
words.en: An indirect object is a noun or pronoun that indicates to whom or for whom the action of the verb is performed.

words.tr:
n. （动词）不定式
adj. 不定式的
words.ex: The infinitive of 'run' is 'to run'.
words.ex_cn: “run”的不定式是“to run”。
words.en: The basic form of a verb, without an inflection binding it to a particular subject or tense.

words.tr: vt. 弯曲；改变；使屈曲; vi. 发生曲折变化
words.ex: The wind inflects the tree branches.
words.ex_cn: 风使树枝弯曲。
words.en: To change the form of a word to express a different grammatical function or attribute; to alter the pitch or tone of the voice.

words.tr: adj. 屈折变化的；风格的
words.ex: The verb is inflected to show past tense.
words.ex_cn: 这个动词被变形以表示过去时。
words.en: Inflected refers to something that has been bent or curved, or to the modification of a word to express different grammatical categories such as tense, mood, voice, aspect, person, number, gender, and case.

words.tr: n. 变音；转调；曲折变化
words.ex: The dog's voice has a happy inflection.
words.ex_cn: 狗的声音带着愉快的语调。
words.en: Inflection refers to the modification of a word to express different grammatical categories such as tense, case, voice, aspect, person, number, gender, and mood.

words.tr: n. 进行时
words.ex: She is reading a book.
words.ex_cn: 她正在读一本书。
words.en: The suffix '-ing' is used to form the present participle of verbs, indicating an ongoing action or state.

words.tr: n. 使更激烈之物，增强剂
words.ex: The use of an intensifier can make the emotion in the story more vivid.
words.ex_cn: 使用增强剂可以使故事中的情感更加生动。
words.en: An intensifier is a word, especially an adverb or adjective, that has little meaning itself but is used to add force to another adjective, verb, or adverb.

words.tr: n. 感叹词；插入之语词
words.ex: He shouted 'Wow!' as an interjection.
words.ex_cn: 他喊了一声‘哇！’作为感叹词。
words.en: An interjection is a word or phrase that expresses a strong feeling or emotion, such as surprise, pleasure, or anger, and is often used in speech to interrupt or emphasize a statement.

words.tr:
adj. 疑问的；质问的
n. 疑问句；疑问词；疑问结构
words.ex: He asked an interrogative sentence to check her understanding.
words.ex_cn: 他问了一个疑问句来检查她的理解。
words.en: An interrogative word or sentence is used to ask a question.

words.tr: phrase. 不及物动词（不需要直接宾语即可构成完整谓语的动词）
words.ex: The word 'laugh' is an intransitive verb.
words.ex_cn: “laugh”是一个不及物动词。
words.en: An intransitive verb is a verb that does not require a direct object to complete its meaning.

words.tr: phrase. 连系动词；系动词（用于连接主语与表语，表示状态或性质，如 be、seem、become 等）
words.ex: She is happy.
words.ex_cn: 她很开心。
words.en: A linking verb is a verb that connects the subject of a sentence to a subject complement, which identifies or describes the subject.

words.tr: phrase. 主句；独立子句（在复合句中可独立成句的核心分句）
words.ex: She smiled because she passed the test. The main clause is 'She smiled'.
words.ex_cn: 她笑了，因为她通过了考试。主句是‘她笑了’。
words.en: A main clause is a clause that can stand alone as a complete sentence; it contains a subject and a predicate.

words.tr: adj. 男子气概的；
words.ex: He has a masculine voice and strong build.
words.ex_cn: 他声音低沉，身材强壮。
words.en: Having qualities or appearance traditionally associated with men.

words.tr: adj. 情态的
words.ex: He used a modal verb to show possibility.
words.ex_cn: 他使用了一个情态动词来表示可能性。
words.en: A modal is a type of auxiliary verb that is used to indicate modality – that is, likelihood, ability, permission, and obligation.

words.tr: phrase. 情态助动词（如 can, may, must, should 等，用来表达可能性、必要性、许可等语气）
words.ex: He uses a modal auxiliary to ask for permission.
words.ex_cn: 他用情态助动词请求许可。
words.en: A modal auxiliary is a type of verb that is used to indicate modality – that is, likelihood, ability, permission, request, capacity, suggestions, order, obligation, or advice.

words.tr: phrase. 情态动词（如 can, may, must, should 等，用于表达可能性、必要性、许可等语气）
words.ex: She can swim very well.
words.ex_cn: 她能游得很好。
words.en: A modal verb is a type of verb that is used to indicate modality – that is: likelihood, ability, permission, request, capacity, suggestions, order, obligation, or advice. Modal verbs always accompany the base form of another verb having semantic content.

words.tr: n. 调节器；修饰语
words.ex: The modifier controls the volume of the speaker.
words.ex_cn: 这个调节器控制扬声器的音量。
words.en: A modifier is a word or phrase that provides additional information about another word or phrase, often to make its meaning more specific.

words.tr: v. 更改；
words.ex: He will modify the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会更改计划。
words.en: To change something slightly, especially in order to make it more suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 心情；情绪；气氛；
words.ex: His mood changed after he heard the good news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个好消息后，心情变了。
words.en: A mood is a temporary state of mind or feeling.

words.tr: n. 氮（元素nitrogen的符号）
words.ex: Nitrogen is a gas, and its symbol is n.
words.ex_cn: 氮是一种气体，它的符号是n。
words.en: The fourteenth letter of the alphabet.

words.tr: adj. 中性的；无生殖器的；无性的; v. 阉割（动物）；使无效，使失去作用；瓦解; n. 中性词...
words.ex: The teacher used a neuter pronoun to avoid gender bias.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用中性代词以避免性别偏见。
words.en: Neuter means to remove the reproductive organs of an animal to prevent it from having offspring, or describes something that is neither masculine nor feminine in gender.

words.tr: adj. 微不足道的；
words.ex: He accepted a nominal fee for the service.
words.ex_cn: 他为这项服务收取了微不足道的费用。
words.en: If you say that something is nominal, you mean that it is very small in comparison to the real value or importance of something.

words.tr: n. <语>主格 adj. 主格的; 具有姓名的
words.ex: The nominative case is used for the subject of a sentence.
words.ex_cn: 主格用于句子的主语。
words.en: In grammar, the nominative is the case used for a noun when it is the subject of a verb. In other contexts, it refers to being nominated for a position or award.

words.tr: phrase. 非限定动词（指不受主语人称、数、时态限制的动词形式，如不定式、分词、动名词）
words.ex: She likes to swim and running in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢在早上游泳和跑步。
words.en: A non-finite verb is a verb form that does not show tense, number, or person. In English, non-finite verbs include infinitives, gerunds, and participles.

words.tr: phrase. 非限定性从句；非限制性定语从句（对先行词仅作补充说明，不用逗号隔开则句子意义仍完整）
words.ex: My brother, who lives in Canada, is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我的哥哥住在加拿大，他是一名老师。
words.en: A non-restrictive clause is a type of adjective clause that provides additional information about a noun whose identity is already clear. It is not essential to the meaning of the sentence and is usually set off by commas.

words.tr: n. 名词
words.ex: Noun is a word for a person, place, or thing.
words.ex_cn: 名词是表示人、地方或事物的词。
words.en: A noun is a word that refers to a person, place, thing, event, substance, or quality.

words.tr: n. 数字；号码；
words.ex: The number on the door is 5.
words.ex_cn: 门上的数字是5。
words.en: A number is a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.tr: v. （对句子）作语法分析
words.ex: The linguist parsed the sentence into its constituent parts.
words.ex_cn: 语言学家将句子分解为其组成部分。
words.en: To parse means to analyze a sentence or string of characters in a computer language into its component parts and describe their syntactic roles.

words.tr: adj. 分词的
words.ex: The boy, crying loudly, ran home.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩大声哭着跑回家。
words.en: Relating to or involving a participle, which is a form of a verb that is used in a sentence to modify a noun or noun phrase.

words.tr: n. 分词
words.ex: The word 'running' is a participle.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'running' 是一个分词。
words.en: A participle is a form of a verb that is used in a sentence to modify a noun, noun phrase, verb, or verb phrase, and thus plays a role similar to an adjective or adverb.

words.tr: n. 微粒；粒子；
words.ex: Dust particles float in the air.
words.ex_cn: 灰尘微粒漂浮在空气中。
words.en: A particle is a very small piece or amount of something.

words.tr: adj. 表示部分的；n. 部分词
words.ex: He used a partitive to show the parts of the whole.
words.ex_cn: 他使用了一个部分数来表示整体的部分。
words.en: A partitive is a word or phrase that indicates a part or quantity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 词类；词性（语法中对词汇按功能分类的类别，如名词、动词、形容词等）
words.ex: The word 'run' can be a noun or a verb; it has two parts of speech.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'run' 可以是名词或动词；它有两个词性。
words.en: A category to which a word is assigned in accordance with its syntactic functions. In English the main parts of speech are noun, pronoun, adjective, determiner, verb, adverb, preposition, conjunction, and interjection.

words.tr: adj. 被动的；
words.ex: He remained passive during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持被动。
words.en: Accepting or allowing what happens or what others do, without active response or resistance.

words.tr: v. 使被动；使消极
words.ex: The teacher will passivize the sentence to show the action.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把这个句子改为被动语态来展示动作。
words.en: To make passive or less active.

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.ex_cn: 他从不谈论过去。
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.tr: phrase. 过去分词（动词的一种非限定形式，常用于完成时、被动语态或作形容词使用）
words.ex: The broken glass was cleaned up by the janitor.
words.ex_cn: 碎玻璃被清洁工打扫了。
words.en: The past participle is a form of a verb that is used in perfect tenses and passive voice in English. It usually ends in -ed, -d, -t, -en, or -n.

words.tr: phrase. 过去完成时（表示在过去某一时间或动作之前已经完成的动作）
words.ex: I had finished my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我在晚饭前已经完成了作业。
words.en: The past perfect is a verb tense used to talk about actions that were completed before some point in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 完成分词；过去分词（表示动作已完成或被动意义）
words.ex: He has finished his homework using the perfect participle.
words.ex_cn: 他用完成分词完成了他的作业。
words.en: A perfect participle is a verb form that is used to indicate completed action. It is often used in perfect tenses and passive voice constructions.

words.tr: n. 迂回说法；折绕
words.ex: He uses periphrasis to sound more polite.
words.ex_cn: 他使用迂回说法来显得更礼貌。
words.en: The use of indirect and circumlocutory speech or writing.

words.tr: phrase. 人称代词（如 I, you, he, she, it, we, they 等）
words.ex: He is my friend.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的朋友。
words.en: A personal pronoun is a pronoun that is associated primarily with a particular person, in the grammatical sense. When discussing 'person' in terms of grammar, the following classifications apply: first person (the speaker), second person (the person spoken to), and third person (the person or thing spoken about).

words.tr: phrase. 短语动词；由动词与副词或介词等组合而成、具有特定意义的动词短语
words.ex: He gave up his old habits.
words.ex_cn: 他放弃了旧习惯。
words.en: A phrasal verb is a combination of a verb and a preposition, a verb and an adverb, or a verb with both an adverb and a preposition, any of which are part of the syntax of the sentence, and so are a complete semantic unit.

words.tr: n. 短语；词组；
words.ex: He learned a new phrase in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一个新的西班牙语短语。
words.en: A phrase is a short group of words that people often use as a way of saying something. The meaning of a phrase is often not obvious from the meaning of the individual words in it.

words.tr: abbr. 复数（plural）
words.ex: The children are playing with toys.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在玩玩具。
words.en: The abbreviation 'pl.' stands for 'plural,' used to indicate that a noun refers to more than one entity.

words.tr: adj. 复数的； n. 复数；
words.ex: The word 'cats' is a plural form.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'cats' 是复数形式。
words.en: The plural form of a word is the form that is used when referring to more than one person or thing.

words.tr: n. 多数状态；诸多
words.ex: She won by a plurality of votes.
words.ex_cn: 她以多数票获胜。
words.en: A plurality in an election is the number of votes that the winner gets, when this is less than a majority.

words.tr:
adj. 不愿分享的；占有欲强的；所有格的
n. 所有格
words.ex: The cat is possessive of its toy.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫对它的玩具很占有。
words.en: If you are possessive about something that you own, you do not like lending it to other people or sharing it with other people.

words.tr: n. 前置限定词
words.ex: This is all the money I have.
words.ex_cn: 这是我所有的钱。
words.en: A predeterminer is a word that is used before another determiner to modify a noun, such as 'all', 'both', or 'half'.

words.tr:
n. 谓语；述语
v. 使基于；断言；宣布
words.ex: He uses a simple predicate to explain the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个简单的谓语来解释这个句子。
words.en: If you predicate something, you base it on or say that it depends on something else. In grammar, the predicate of a clause is the part of it that is not the subject.

words.tr: adj. 谓语性的，表语的；（指动词 be 用法）对主语作出断言的；（逻）作谓项的
words.ex: The word 'happy' is a predicative adjective in the sentence 'She is happy'.
words.ex_cn: 在句子 'She is happy' 中，'happy' 是一个表语形容词。
words.en: A grammatical element that follows a linking verb and describes the subject, as in 'She is happy'.

words.tr:
n. 前缀
v. 在…前面加
words.ex: He adds a prefix to the word to change its meaning.
words.ex_cn: 他在单词前加上前缀来改变它的意思。
words.en: A prefix is a letter or group of letters added at the beginning of a word to change its meaning.

words.tr: n. 介词
words.ex: He used 'in' as a preposition in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他在句子中用 'in' 作为介词。
words.en: A preposition is a word such as 'by', 'for', 'into', or 'with' which usually has a noun group as its object.

words.tr: phrase. 介词短语；前置词短语（由介词及其宾语构成的短语，在句中作状语、定语等成分）
words.ex: A prepositional phrase starts with a preposition and ends with a noun.
words.ex_cn: 介词短语以介词开头，以名词结尾。
words.en: A prepositional phrase is a group of words consisting of a preposition, its object, and any words that modify the object. It often functions as an adjective or adverb in a sentence.

words.tr: phrase. 现在分词（动词-ing形式，用于进行时、作定语、状语等）
words.ex: The present participle of 'run' is 'running'.
words.ex_cn: “run”的现在分词是“running”。
words.en: A present participle is a form of a verb that ends in -ing and is used in continuous tenses or as an adjective.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；前进的；
words.ex: This school uses a progressive teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用一种先进的教学方法。
words.en: A progressive person or idea is one that is modern and new, and is interested in change and improvement.

words.tr: adj. 代词的；代词性质的
words.ex: In some languages, the pronominal system is very complex.
words.ex_cn: 在一些语言中，代词系统非常复杂。
words.en: Relating to or functioning as a pronoun.

words.tr: n. 代词
words.ex: He used 'she' as a pronoun in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他在句子中用'she'作为代词。
words.en: A pronoun is a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase. Pronouns refer to either a noun that has already been mentioned or to a noun that does not need to be named specifically.

words.tr: phrase. 专有名词；指特定人、地、机构等首字母常大写的名词
words.ex: New York is a proper noun.
words.ex_cn: 纽约是一个专有名词。
words.en: A proper noun is the name of a particular person, place, or thing and is usually written with a capital letter.

words.tr: v. 加标点于；强调；不时打断
words.ex: She punctuates her sentences with commas.
words.ex_cn: 她用逗号给句子加标点。
words.en: To punctuate means to add punctuation marks to text in order to clarify meaning and separate structural units. It can also mean to interrupt or emphasize something at intervals.

words.tr: n. 标点符号
words.ex: He forgot the punctuation in his sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他忘记在句子中加标点符号了。
words.en: Punctuation refers to the marks used in writing to separate sentences and their elements and to clarify meaning.

words.tr: n. 合格者；限定词；预选赛
words.ex: He is a qualifier for the final race.
words.ex_cn: 他是进入决赛的选手。
words.en: A qualifier is a word or phrase, especially an adjective, that you use to describe another word in order to limit its meaning or to make it less general.

words.tr: n. 数量词；量词
words.ex: In logic, a quantifier is used to express the quantity of individuals for which a predicate holds.
words.ex_cn: 在逻辑学中，量词用于表达谓词所适用的个体数量。
words.en: A quantifier is a word or phrase which is used before a noun to indicate the amount or quantity.

words.tr: phrase. 疑问尾句；附加疑问句（置于陈述句末的简短问句，如“You’re coming, aren’t you?”）
words.ex: You like apples, don't you?
words.ex_cn: 你喜欢苹果，是吧？
words.en: A question tag is a grammatical structure in which a declarative statement is turned into a question by the addition of an interrogative fragment (the 'tag').

words.tr: adj. 条件反射的；反身的
words.ex: The reflexive response to bright light is to close the eyes.
words.ex_cn: 对强光的条件反射是闭上眼睛。
words.en: A reflexive action or movement is one that you do without thinking about it because it is a natural reaction to a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 规则动词（指按固定词尾变化构成过去式、过去分词的动词，如 walk-walked-walked）
words.ex: He walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天步行去学校。
words.en: A regular verb is a verb that follows the standard patterns of inflection in the language to which it belongs.

words.tr: phrase. 不规则动词（过去式或过去分词不以-ed结尾的动词）
words.ex: He learns irregular verbs in English class.
words.ex_cn: 他在英语课上学习不规则动词。
words.en: An irregular verb is a verb that does not follow the normal patterns of inflection in its conjugation.

words.tr: phrase. 关系从句；定语从句
words.ex: A relative clause gives more information about a noun.
words.ex_cn: 一个定语从句提供关于名词的更多信息。
words.en: A relative clause is a clause introduced by a relative pronoun, relative adverb, or zero relative, which modifies a noun or pronoun by providing additional information about it.

words.tr: phrase. 关系代词（如 who, which, that 等，用于引导定语从句）
words.ex: A relative pronoun connects a noun to a sentence.
words.ex_cn: 关系代词将名词和句子连接起来。
words.en: A relative pronoun is a pronoun used to connect a clause or phrase to a noun or pronoun, such as 'who', 'which', or 'that'.

words.tr: phrase. 间接引语；转述引语（把别人的话转述时所用的语法形式，通常涉及时态、代词等的变化）
words.ex: He said that he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他说他累了。
words.en: Reported speech is when you tell somebody else what you or another person said before.

words.tr: phrase. 限制性从句；限定性从句（在句中对先行词起限定作用，去掉后句子意义不完整，通常不用逗号隔开）
words.ex: The book that I borrowed is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我借的那本书在桌子上。
words.en: A restrictive clause is a clause which functions as an adjective to identify or define the noun it modifies more precisely. It is not set off by commas.

words.tr:
n. 根；根源；
v. 生根；
words.ex: The root of 9 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 9的平方根是3。
words.en: The root of a plant is the part that grows underground and absorbs water and minerals. It can also refer to the origin or cause of something.

words.tr:
n. 规则；统治；
v. 统治；
words.ex: The teacher made a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了一个新的作业规则。
words.en: A rule is a statement telling people what they should do in order to achieve success or a benefit of some kind.

words.tr: phrase. 连写句；串句（指两个或多个独立分句未用恰当标点或连词而直接连在一起的不规范句子）
words.ex: A run-on sentence has two complete thoughts without a proper connector.
words.ex_cn: 一个连写句包含两个完整的想法，但没有使用适当的连接词。
words.en: A run-on sentence is a sentence in which two or more independent clauses are joined without appropriate punctuation or conjunction.

words.tr: phrase. 第二人称；指说话时所面对的人（如 you）
words.ex: The second person says 'you' in a sentence.
words.ex_cn: 第二人称在句子中说'你'。
words.en: The grammatical category of a pronoun or verb form that refers directly to the person being addressed, as in 'you'.

words.tr: n. 分号
words.ex: He used a semicolon to join two sentences.
words.ex_cn: 他用分号连接了两个句子。
words.en: A semicolon is a punctuation mark (;) used to separate parts of a sentence that are more distinct than those separated by a comma.

words.tr: n. 句子；判决；宣判；
words.ex: This sentence is easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子很容易理解。
words.en: A sentence is a group of words which, when they are written down, begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop, question mark, or exclamation mark. Most sentences contain a subject and a verb.

words.tr: phrase. 句子副词；修饰整个句子而非单个动词或形容词的副词
words.ex: Surprisingly, he passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 令人惊讶的是，他通过了考试。
words.en: A sentence adverb is an adverb that modifies a whole sentence or clause within a sentence.

words.tr: adj. 单个的；单数的；特异的；
words.ex: Each singular student must submit a form.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都必须提交一份表格。
words.en: In grammar, singular means relating to or being a form of a word that refers to one person or thing.

words.tr: n. 违反语法；文法错误；举止失礼
words.ex: He made a solecism when he said 'between you and I'.
words.ex_cn: 当他说出'between you and I'时，犯了一个语法错误。
words.en: A solecism is a grammatical mistake in speech or writing, or a breach of etiquette.

words.tr: phrase. （英语语法中）被副词或其他词语分隔开的不定式，如 'to boldly go'
words.ex: He wants to quickly finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他想快速完成作业。
words.en: A split infinitive is a grammatical construction in which a word or phrase comes between the 'to' and the bare infinitive of the verb.

words.tr: phrase. 状态动词：表示状态、感觉、认知或拥有的动词，而非动作，如 'know', 'belong', 'love' 等
words.ex: She likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: A stative verb is a verb that describes a state rather than an action. Stative verbs often relate to emotions, possession, sense, or thoughts.

words.tr:
n. 茎；词干；
v. 起源于(~ from)；
words.ex: The flower grows on a long green stem.
words.ex_cn: 花长在一根长长的绿色茎上。
words.en: The main body or stalk of a plant or shrub, typically rising above ground but occasionally subterranean; to stop or restrict (the flow of something).

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.tr: adj. 主观的
words.ex: His opinion is subjective and not based on facts.
words.ex_cn: 他的观点是主观的，不是基于事实的。
words.en: Based on or influenced by personal feelings, tastes, or opinions.

words.tr:
adj. 虚拟语气的
n. 虚拟语气；虚拟式
words.ex: In English, the subjunctive mood is often used to express hypothetical situations.
words.ex_cn: 在英语中，虚拟语气常用于表达假设的情况。
words.en: The subjunctive is a verb form or mood used to express hypothetical or non-real actions, events, or situations.

words.tr: phrase. 从属子句；从句（在复合句中不能独立成句，需依附主句表达完整意义）
words.ex: She left when the bell rang, which is a subordinate clause.
words.ex_cn: 当铃声响起时她离开了，这是一个从句。
words.en: A subordinate clause is a clause that cannot stand alone as a complete sentence; it must be connected to a main clause.

words.tr: adj. 本质上的；实质性的；
words.ex: The change was substantive, not just cosmetic.
words.ex_cn: 这个改变是本质上的，而不仅仅是表面上的。
words.en: Something that is substantive is significant, meaningful, or important in a way that is not just superficial or formal.

words.tr: n. 后缀；词尾
words.ex: He added a suffix to the word to change its meaning.
words.ex_cn: 他在单词后添加了一个后缀来改变它的意思。
words.en: A suffix is a letter or group of letters added at the end of a word which makes a new word.

words.tr:
adj. 最佳的；最高级的；过度的
n. 最高级；最高程度
words.ex: This is the superlative movie I have ever seen.
words.ex_cn: 这是我见过的最棒的电影。
words.en: The superlative form of an adjective or adverb is the form that indicates that something has more of a quality than anything else in a particular group.

words.tr: adj. 句法的
words.ex: The child made a syntactic error in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在句子中犯了一个句法错误。
words.en: relating to or according to the rules of syntax

words.tr: n. 句法；
words.ex: He learned syntax from his English teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他从英语老师那里学习了句法。
words.en: Syntax is the grammatical arrangement of words in a sentence.

words.tr:
n. 标签；标记；
v. 加标签于；
words.ex: The tag on the shirt says 'wash cold'.
words.ex_cn: 衬衫上的标签写着‘冷水洗涤’。
words.en: A tag is a small piece of card, cloth, or plastic which is attached to an object or person and has information about that object or person on it. A tag can also be a word or phrase that is used to describe or identify something, especially in a computer file or on a website.

words.tr:
adj. 紧张的；拉紧的；
n. 时态；
words.ex: He felt tense before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张。
words.en: If you are tense, you are anxious and nervous and cannot relax.

words.tr: phrase. 及物动词（需要带宾语的动词）
words.ex: She gave him a book.
words.ex_cn: 她给了他一本书。
words.en: A transitive verb is a verb that requires one or more objects in a sentence to complete its meaning.

words.tr: adj. 无数的; 不可数的 n. <语>不可数名词
words.ex: There is uncountable sand on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 海滩上有无数的沙子。
words.en: If a noun is uncountable, it refers to something that cannot be counted because it is seen as a whole or mass, rather than as individual items.

words.tr: n. 变体；
words.ex: This apple is a variant of the red delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这种苹果是红富士的一个变体。
words.en: A variant is something that is slightly different from other similar things.

words.tr: n. 动词
words.ex: In the sentence 'She runs', 'runs' is a verb.
words.ex_cn: 在句子 'She runs' 中，'runs' 是一个动词。
words.en: A word that is used to describe an action, state, or occurrence, and forming the main part of the predicate of a sentence, such as 'run', 'become', or 'happen'.

words.tr: adj. 口头的；语言的；
words.ex: He gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他给了一个口头警告，而不是书面的。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of words.

words.tr: phrase. 动名词；由动词派生、具有名词功能的词
words.ex: Swimming is a good exercise.
words.ex_cn: 游泳是一项很好的运动。
words.en: A verbal noun is a noun formed from a verb, often ending in -ing in English, that functions as a noun in a sentence.

words.tr:
adj. 呼格的（语法）
n. 呼格（词）
words.ex: He used 'friend' as a vocative in his letter.
words.ex_cn: 他在信中用'朋友'作为呼语。
words.en: The vocative case is a grammatical case used for a noun that identifies a person (animal, object, etc.) being addressed and/or is the subject of the sentence.
